home.intro: Developer, beekeeper, and maker of all sorts. I build thoughtful, accessible things for the web. Away from the keyboard, the curiosity carries on.

work.heading: Software with people in mind.
work.body: The most important part of my work as a developer is creating solutions that put the people using them first. Whether it's user experience and accessibility or developer experience, I want to make everyday life easier for others.

development.heading: From interface to database.
development.body: I'm a full-stack developer at {employer}. I build frontends with Angular and Vue, backends and APIs with .NET/C#, and work with the databases behind them. I use Azure as the cloud platform. I enjoy working on a solution as a whole and making sure all the parts work well together.

work.link: More about my work on LinkedIn

sewing.heading: One stitch at a time.
sewing.body: Sewing is one of the ways I like to spend my free time. It brings me a lot of creative joy and lets me make unique, personal garments that fit me perfectly. And mending helps those clothes last longer!

printing.heading: From a problem to a tangible solution.
printing.body: I also use 3D modelling and printing to solve practical problems and repair things. This lets me adapt things to my needs so they work as well as possible.

making.heading: Different tools. Same curiosity.
making.body: Small electronics projects, woodworking, and knitting are other ways I enjoy making things. I love learning new techniques, experimenting with different materials, and figuring out how to make things myself.

beekeeping.heading: A calm mind, with heavy lifting.
beekeeping.body: Beekeeping is another part of my life. There's a lot to learn and always new challenges to tackle. Spending time in the apiary feels like meditation that gives a sense of inner peace, even if the work is heavy.

other.heading: Between projects.
other.body: A good book (preferably fantasy), a video game, or a board game. I also like having room for things that don't need a plan or a finished result.
